ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure is a large triangle ADC, D is at the upper left, A is on the right side, and C is below. Point E is on side AD, and point B is on side AC. Pink arrows in the figure mark that EB is parallel to DC. It is known that AE=3, AB=2, BC=6, and ED=2x-3. Then reason: Because EB ∥ DC, the corresponding segments cut out are proportional. From the figure, AD is divided into AE and ED, and AC is divided into AB and BC, so there is AE/ED = AB/BC. Substitute the values: 3/ED = 2/6 = 1/3. Cross-multiplying gives ED = 9. Therefore the value of ED is 9.

method.method_draft: Read the diagram as showing smaller triangle AEB inside larger triangle ADC, sharing angle A, with EB parallel to DC. From the text, compute AC=AB+BC=2+6=8. Since EB ∥ DC, triangles AEB and ADC are similar, so AB/AC = AE/AD. Substitute 2/8 = 3/AD to get AD=12. Then ED is the remaining part of AD after AE, so ED=AD-AE=12-3=9. Equivalently, if using ED=2x-3, then AD=AE+ED=3+(2x-3)=2x and 3/(2x)=2/8 gives x=6, hence ED=9.

推理：已知 AB=2，BC=6，所以 AC=AB+BC=2+6=8。由于 EB ∥ DC，三角形 AEB 与三角形 ADC 相似。对应边成比例：AB/AC = AE/AD。代入数值：2/8 = 3/AD。解得 AD=12。因为 E 在 AD 上，ED 是 AD 去掉 AE 后的部分，所以 ED=AD-AE=12-3=9。
